name: cubitosmusic
description: Bot de música para Discord: yt-dlp, panel interactivo, cola por servidor y logs de reproducción.

scripts.context: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');const path=require('node:path');const out='contexto_bot.txt';const files=[];function walk(dir){for(const e of fs.readdirSync(dir,{withFileTypes:true})){const p=path.join(dir,e.name);if(e.isDirectory()){if(e.name==='node_modules'||e.name==='dist'||e.name==='.git')continue;walk(p);}else if(e.isFile()){files.push(p);}}}walk('src');files.unshift(...['package.json','AGENTS.md','HANDOFF.md'].filter(f=>fs.existsSync(f)));let content='';for(const f of files){content+='=== '+f.split(path.sep).join('/')+' ===\n'+fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8')+'\n';}fs.writeFileSync(out,content);console.log('Generado '+out+' con '+files.length+' archivos');"
